_comment: Binds each eval rule to the LIVE agent file it tests. The generator slices the text between `start` (inclusive) and `end` (exclusive) at generate time, so the `current` variant always tests what ships — no copy to drift. Paths are relative to evals/. If change (B) rewords a rule, keep its `start`/`end` anchor lines stable (the bold title / heading) so this keeps resolving.
